description: This file defines the SkillAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing 'Skill' entities within the OrangeHRM administrative module. It provides CRUD operations, validation rules, and interaction with the SkillService for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting skill records.

classes.name: SkillAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing skills, including get, list, create, update, and delete operations for 'Skill' entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the SkillService instance managing skill data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Skill by its ID, returning it in API model form.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of skills based on search filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Skill record with data provided in the request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Skill identified by ID with data from the request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple Skills identified by their IDs provided in the request.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Populates a Skill entity with request data and saves it via SkillService.
